title: Xanthe and the Safehouse
author: Hazel Crane
blurb: August Whitlock, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
